scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Alankar Yojana for Students of Economically Weaker Section
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Student must be studying in government schools in Rajasthan
Student must be enrolled in class 10 or class 12
Student must belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS)
Student must have secured the highest marks in the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education examinations for the respective class and stream
Students benefiting from other incentive schemes are also eligible
benefits_summary: Each selected student receives a one-time cash award of ₹50,000 and a Certificate of Appreciation.
